* 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）。
description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive—you must provide one and only one of them.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).

description.zh:
* 本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
* 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
* 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可。
description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive—you must provide one and only one of them.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When invoking via software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云通用文字识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于各类常见文档图片或文档扫描件中的文字信息按照文档原有的格式智能识别文字并结构化输出识别结果。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |全字段识别|结构化识别图片上所包含的全字段，并返回JSON。| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |高精度高性能|超高精度及性能；识别准确率位于行业前列，识别速度显著高于国内其他OCR云服务。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [通用文字识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=general_text#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[通用文字识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0908%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeGeneral?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 接口响应速度和图片中的文字数量有关，如果图片中文字数量越多，接口响应可能越慢。
  • 接口会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud General Text Recognition is an official self-developed OCR product from Alibaba Cloud. It intelligently recognizes text in common document images or scanned documents and outputs the recognition results in a structured format that preserves the original layout of the document. * Built on DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and vast data resources, Alibaba Cloud's OCR product has been refined over years of development. It offers high stability, ease of use, real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API

#### Core Capabilities of This API | Category | Overview | |---|---------| | Multi-type Coverage | Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as blurry images, images with uneven lighting, perspective distortion, or arbitrary backgrounds. | | Full-field Recognition | Structurally recognizes all fields present in the image and returns results in JSON format. | | Image Enhancement | Enables image enhancement by default, including automatic correction of image distortion and enhancement of blurry images. | | High Accuracy and Performance | Delivers industry-leading recognition accuracy and significantly faster recognition speed compared to other domestic OCR cloud services. | #### How to Use This API | Step | Overview | |--|---| | 1 | Activate the [General Text Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com?commodityCode=ocr_general_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test this feature via the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=universal&subtype=general_text#intro). | | 2 | Purchase a [General Text Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_general_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_general_dp_cn_20211103172431_0908%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota that you can use for testing. | | 3 | Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeGeneral?sdkStyle=dara) to integrate the API into your application. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the recognition result. If you are using a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM User](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on how to attach this policy, see [Grant Permissions to a RAM User on the Users Page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html). | #### Important Notes | Type | Overview | |----|-------------------| | Image Format |
  • Supported formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP. PDF format is not currently supported.
| | Image Dimensions |
  • Both height and width must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (longer side divided by shorter side) must be less than 50.
  • For optimal recognition results, we recommend that both dimensions exceed 500 pixels.
| | Image Size |
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may slow down API response time. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| | Other Tips |
  • API response time depends on the amount of text in the image—more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare or distortion, but this may affect accuracy. Whenever possible, use high-definition images without glare or distortion.
|
